78473-reflections-of-a-beginning-husband.creator: Edward Sandford Martin
78473-reflections-of-a-beginning-husband.description: A book by Edward Sandford Martin. n the way of her marrying any one else. The thing that had bothered me was to have the engagement end without our being married. I wanted to have it die a natural death in church, with flowers and a minister, and it had irked me very sore indeed to be “released” like a baseball-player before the end of the season.

arxiv-2106-14556.title: Contrastive Counterfactual Visual Explanations With Overdetermination CCS: Computing methodologies Computer vision CCS: Computing methodologies Interest point and salient region detections CCS: Computing methodologies Image segmentation CCS: Computing methodologies Causal reasoning and diagnostics C
arxiv-2106-14556.creator: Adam White, Kwun Ho Ngan, James Phelan, Saman Sadeghi Afgeh, Kevin Ryan, Constantino Carlos Reyes-Aldasoro, Artur d’Avila Garcez
arxiv-2106-14556.description: Abstract . A novel explainable AI method called CLEAR Image is introduced in this paper. CLEAR Image is based on the view that a satisfactory explanation should be contrastive, counterfactual and measurable. CLEAR Image explains an image’s classification probability by contrasting the image with a corresponding image generated automatically via adversarial learning.

arxiv-2308-01763.title: Janus-faced tomograms and retrieval of quadrature moments for q q -deformed states
arxiv-2308-01763.creator: S. Kannan, C. Sudheesh
arxiv-2308-01763.description: Abstract In this work, we derive the optical tomograms of various q q -deformed quantum states. We found that the optical tomograms of the states under consideration exhibit a fascinating ‘Janus faced’ nature, irrespective of the deformation parameter q q .

arxiv-2402-19068.title: Two-scale model of quasi-steady flow of electrolyte in weakly piezoelectric porous media
arxiv-2402-19068.creator: Jana Camprová Turjanicová, Eduard Rohan
arxiv-2402-19068.description: Abstract This paper presents a new homogenized model of two-component electrolyte transport through a weakly piezoelectric porous medium. The model relevant to the microscopic scale describes quasi-stationary states of the medium while reflecting essential physical phenomena, such as electrochemical interactions in a dilute Newtonian solvent under assumptions of slow flow.

arxiv-2409-11481.title: The MDW H α \alpha Sky Survey: Data Release 0
arxiv-2409-11481.creator: Noor Aftab, Xunhe (Andrew) Zhang, David R. Mittelman, Dennis di Cicco, Sean Walker, David H. Sliski, Julia Homa, Colin Holm-Hansen, Mary Putman, David Schiminovich, Arne Henden, Gary Walker
arxiv-2409-11481.description: Abstract The Mittelman-di Cicco-Walker (MDW) H α \alpha Sky Survey is an autonomously-operated and ongoing all-sky imaging survey in the narrowband H α \alpha wavelength. The survey was founded by amateur astronomers, and is presented here in its first stage of refinement for rigorous scientific use.

arxiv-2505-09513.title: The construction and use of dephasing prescriptions for environmental effects in gravitational wave astronomy
arxiv-2505-09513.creator: János Takátsy 1,2, Lorenz Zwick 1,2, Kai Hendriks 1,2, Pankaj Saini 1,2, Gaia Fabj 1,2, Johan Samsing 1,2
arxiv-2505-09513.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by János Takátsy 1,2, Lorenz Zwick 1,2, Kai Hendriks 1,2, Pankaj Saini 1,2, Gaia Fabj 1,2, Johan Samsing 1,2. In the first part of this work, we provide a curated overview of the theoretical framework necessary for incorporating dephasing due to environmental effects (EE) in gravitational wave (GW) templates. We focus in particular on the relationship between orbital perturbations in the time-domain and the resulting dephasing in both time and frequency domain, elucidating and resolving some inconsistencies present in the literature.

arxiv-2510-20617.title: Approximating evidence via bounded harmonic means
arxiv-2510-20617.creator: Dana Naderi, Christian P Robert, Kaniav Kamary, Darren Wraith
arxiv-2510-20617.description: Abstract Efficient Bayesian model selection relies on the model evidence or marginal likelihood, whose computation often requires evaluating an intractable integral. The harmonic mean estimator (HME) has long been a standard method of approximating the evidence. While computationally simple, the version introduced by Newton and Raftery 1994 potentially suffers from infinite variance.

arxiv-2512-19026.title: Finer-Personalization Rank : Fine-Grained Retrieval Examines Identity Preservation for Personalized Generation
arxiv-2512-19026.creator: Connor Kilrain, David Carlyn, Julia Chae, Sara Beery, Wei-Lun Chao, Jianyang Gu
arxiv-2512-19026.description: Abstract The rise of personalized generative models raises a central question: how should we evaluate identity preservation? Given a reference image ( e.g . , one’s pet), we expect the generated image to retain precise details attached to the subject’s identity.

Expansion of a CAG repeat in the coding region of exon 1 in the ATXN2 gene located in human chromosome 12q24.1 causes the neurodegenerative disease spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (SCA2). pmc-11380024.title: Resiliency planning of distribution network using of active distribution network partitioning
pmc-11380024.creator: Hamid Amini Khanavandi, Majid Gandomkar, Javad Nikoukar
pmc-11380024.description: Today, micro-grids (MGs) include all kinds of energy storage systems (ESSs), wind turbines (WTs), photovoltaic (PV), combined heat and power (CHP), etc., also demand response are active on the demand side. In this paper, single-level robust methods for partitioning and planning the active distribution network (ADN) into several MGs are presented.

pmc-12361394.title: Precise correction of G6PD Viangchan mutation in iPSCs by prime editing strategy
pmc-12361394.creator: Chaiwat Netsawang, Malinee Tongbaen, Natee Jearawiriyapaisarn, Kamonlak Leecharoenkiat
pmc-12361394.description: Individuals with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency hold a significant risk of severe hemolytic crises under oxidative stress. Currently, the definitive and curative treatment for the disorder has not been developed. Among over 200 G6PD variants, G6PD Viangchan (c.871 G > A) is the most prevalent and has been extensively studied in Southeast Asia.

pmc-12538901.title: App-based automated meal analysis in adults with type 1 diabetes using automated insulin delivery: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12538901.creator: Camillo D Piazza, Céline I Laesser, Lum Kastrati, Katharine Barnard-Kelly, Christos T Nakas, David Herzig, Lia Bally
pmc-12538901.description: SummaryBackgroundImage-based automated meal analysis using smartphones has the potential to facilitate meal management in type 1 diabetes. We evaluated the glycaemic efficacy of SNAQ–an image-based automated meal analysis app–in adults using hybrid automated insulin delivery (AID) systems requiring carbohydrate entry for prandial insulin dosing.

pmc-12564694.title: Understanding Peritoneal Fluid Estrogen and Progesterone Concentrations Permits Individualization of Medical Treatment of Endometriosis-Associated Pain with Lower Doses, Especially in Adolescents Not Requiring Contraception
pmc-12564694.creator: Philippe R Koninckx, Anastasia Ussia, Leila Adamyan, Arnaud Wattiez, Paola Vigano, Alberto Revelli, Erich Cosmi
pmc-12564694.description: Objectives: The aim of this study was to review the importance of peritoneal fluid steroid hormone concentrations to understand the mechanism of hormonal medical treatment of endometriosis-associated pain. Design: The study included a PubMed search and a pilot trial in 8 adolescents.

pmc-12567358.creator: Leo Štefan, Ivan Sušanj, Jadranka Buljević, Marin Roje, Mladenka Jurin, Anđela Buljan, Tamara Rinkovec, Robert Vianello, Marijana Pocrnić, Nives Galić, Ana Čikoš
pmc-12567358.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Lifitegrast is a recent therapeutic agent provoking scientific and regulatory interest due to its outstanding safety profile and high efficacy in the treatment of dry eye disease. Methods: Herein we employ NMR spectroscopy and mass spectrometry to investigate the weak spots of lifitegrast under standard to extreme stress conditions, resulting in the characterization of three known and nine new degradation products (of which DP7 presented the greatest structural challenge, but was eventually determined as C10 hydroxy derivative, warranting a revision of

pmc-12851635.title: Levamisole-Adulterated Cocaine: A Case of Vasculitis and Severe Neutropenia
pmc-12851635.creator: Bartholomew Olash
pmc-12851635.description: Levamisole is an immunomodulatory agent that was formerly used in the United States as a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARD) for rheumatoid arthritis (RA). More recently, it has become a common adulterant in cocaine. Levamisole exposure has been associated with a broad spectrum of adverse effects, such as neutropenia, agranulocytosis, distinctive skin lesions, vasculitis, arthralgias, and leukoencephalopathy.

pmc-12950082.title: Turkish urologists’ knowledge and attitudes on lifestyle advice for bladder cancer: a national survey
pmc-12950082.creator: Reha Girgin, Necmettin Aydın Mungan
pmc-12950082.description: PurposeTo evaluate the knowledge level of Turkish urologists regarding the lifestyle changes related to bladder cancer and to what extent they question patients’ lifestyles and guide them in making recommended changes.MethodsA 14-question online survey, based on a questionnaire prepared by Beeren et al. (Bladder Cancer 10(3):215-220, 2024), was sent to Turkish urologists.

pmc-12976657.title: Neural Architecture of Familiar Person Perception: Contributions of Unimodal and Multimodal Brain Regions
pmc-12976657.creator: Tianxing Zheng, Stefania Mattioni, Olivier Collignon, Xiaoqing Gao
pmc-12976657.description: Faces and voices provide essential information for recognizing familiar people. The brain regions involved in processing person familiarity through these modalities have typically been studied independently, leaving unclear whether and where the auditory and visual networks overlap. In this study, we developed a novel frequency‐tagging‐based fMRI paradigm to examine the neural basis of familiarity processing from a multimodal perspective.

pmc-13090527.title: Age‐Dependent Differences in Canakinumab Safety: A Comprehensive Pharmacovigilance Analysis Using the FAERS Database
pmc-13090527.creator: Youyang Wang, Ngasin Lam, Xiaoming Huang, Yang Jiao
pmc-13090527.description: While the efficacy of canakinumab, an anti‐interleukin‐1β monoclonal antibody, is well‐established, its safety profile, particularly across different age groups, remains inadequately explored. Using the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database, this study evaluated postmarketing safety by analyzing adverse event (AE) reports from 2010 onward, with canakinumab as the primary suspected drug.

pmc-13201660.title: Mapping human pre-rRNA processing and modification at single nucleotide resolution using long read nanopore sequencing
pmc-13201660.creator: Stefan Pastore, Ludivine Wacheul, Lioba Lehmann, Stefan Mündnich, Beat Lutz, Mark Helm, Susanne Gerber, Denis L. J. Lafontaine, Tamer Butto
pmc-13201660.description: Ribosome biogenesis requires the synthesis and sequential processing of precursor rRNAs (pre-rRNAs) into mature rRNAs. Traditional methods such as northern blotting and metabolic labeling provide limited resolution. Here, we present NanoRibolyzer, a nanopore-based long-read sequencing approach that enables ab initio identification and quantification of rRNA precursors while simultaneously mapping RNA modifications.

pmc-13300453.title: A novel leadless pacemaker powered by a piezoelectric energy harvester
pmc-13300453.creator: V Reddy, N J Melhem, D Shav, P Friedman, P Neuzil, E Marijon, P Defaye
pmc-13300453.description: IntroductionEnergy harvesters that convert biomechanical energy into electrical power could be used for implantable devices, providing a near-infinite energy solution. While various energy harvesters with piezoelectric or triboelectric elements have been designed and applied to the cardiac environment, none have been successfully integrated into leadless pacemakers due to their size constraints or insufficient energy generation.

pmc-13515251.creator: Xiaoda Cao, Haiwang Li, Shizhe Song, Tiantong Xu, Yanxin Zhai
pmc-13515251.description: MEMS capacitive pressure sensors are one of the major classes of pressure sensors. However, in the non-contact operating mode, their sensitivity often varies nonlinearly with the applied pressure, which increases the difficulty and workload of sensitivity evaluation at multiple pressure points during the design stage.
